test_name: System and Communications Protection - SC-13 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Benefits-Portal-175
Primary NIST family: System and Communications Protection (SC); evidence focus: SC-13.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: sensitive data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed keys and key access is tightly restricted. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
